policy.meta_native_metric: Use Meta Click-to-WhatsApp / messaging conversation metrics when the ad objective/destination is WhatsApp and the selected WhatsApp asset matches this ID.
policy.first_party_metric: Use kryo_leads for WhatsApp signup/lead and kryo_deposit_events for deposit outcomes, joined by experiment_id, experiment_key, landing_page_version, angle_id, hook_id and Meta IDs.
policy.meta_signup_metric: For website WhatsApp access form submissions, send Meta Conversions API event_name=Lead with custom_data.lead_type=whatsapp_signup when META_PIXEL_ID and META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN are configured.
